note: Starting vault for Tallyho, a fictional polls and community app used as a test brand. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place or figure. The numbers are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Votes a week
vault.body: 10,000 votes are cast in Tallyho groups every week (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Meetup days picked fast
vault.body: 80% of crews pick a meetup day within an hour of the poll going up (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Groups on Tallyho
vault.body: 1,000 community groups ask their members a question on Tallyho each month (illustrative figure).

vault.title: How a poll works
vault.body: A group admin asks one question with up to four answers; members vote from the app and everyone sees the result when the poll closes.

vault.title: The group plan
vault.body: The group plan gives a crew of up to 50 members unlimited polls, free this winter (invented offer).

vault.title: Quiz night for builders
vault.body: Tallyho holds a quiz night for community builders at The Loft, an invented venue on Harbour Street, on Friday 8 January at 6pm. Entry is free with an account.

vault.title: Planned features (internal)
vault.body: An example of an internal note: plans that are not public yet. The tag not-for-posts tells reviewers to keep it out of posts.
